In this episode, I break down dozens of real, practical ways to turn unwanted or unloved land into cash flowing businesses. I walk through ideas ranging from RV pads, sheds, tiny homes, parking, storage, and camping, all the way to tree farms, firewood, EV charging, sports courts, pop-ups, and traffic based monetization. The big takeaway is simple. If you own land, even ugly land, there are countless ways to cover the payment and build serious income if you think creatively and are willing to execute.
